title: Deploy pipeline check
lede: A small deploy pipeline, modelled from its workflow file and deploy script. Five of the seven checks fail. A failed build stops for good, nobody owns the approval, and a bad deploy can roll back and retry forever.
source: An invented pipeline that ships with the skill as examples/deploy.json. The file:line evidence points at files that do not exist. The cards and picks are written by hand.

seen.title: The message you saw
text: No edge leaves refused, so the deploy stays there. Nobody is told, and nothing asks for a new build.
The pipeline declares abandoned as an end, but no edge leads to it. The one way a deploy could stop on purpose does not exist.

cards.title: A failed build is a trap
cards.problem: building goes to refused on a red build (pipeline.yml:34), and nothing leaves refused.

options.text: Tell the engineer, and abandon the deploy after 7 days with no new build.
Let the engineer retry from refused, with at most 3 retries.
Make refused an end. A new build is a new deploy.

cards.pick: a. It also gives abandoned its first edge.

cards.title: abandoned can never happen
cards.problem: abandoned is in the ends, but no transition leads to it.

options.text: Wire it from refused and from a stale approval, as F1 and F3 propose.

cards.title: The approval waits on nobody in particular
cards.problem: awaiting_approval ends only when an approver clicks (pipeline.yml:41). Nothing names who, and nothing times out.

options.text: Name the on-call approver as the owner and send them the request.
Abandon the deploy after 24 hours with no answer.
Approve automatically when the build is green.

cards.title: A build can hang with nobody watching
cards.problem: building waits on CI, which has no owner and no timeout.

options.text: Fail the build after 30 minutes and tell the engineer.
Show the build's age on the deploy page.

cards.title: Rollback and retry can loop forever
cards.problem: rolling_back returns to requested (deploy.sh:110), which builds and deploys again. Nothing counts the rounds.

options.text: Count the rollbacks, and abandon the deploy after the second one.
Send a rolled-back deploy to refused instead of requested.

trust: This pipeline is invented to show the page. Run the skill on your own code to get a table with real evidence.
